script.title: MUSEUM TICKETS
script.scene_zh: 博物館 · 售票口買票
script.story_hook: Two visitors buy timed tickets at a packed museum.
script.intro_zh: 兩位遊客在擁擠的博物館售票口購買時段門票。
script.welcome_en: Hello everyone, glad you're here! Today we're at a museum ticket window.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好，很高興見到你！今天我們來到博物館的售票口。
script.outro: And that's today's museum trip. Listen again whenever you like.
script.outro_zh: 今天的博物館之行就到這裡。隨時都可以再聽一遍。
script.practice_intro_en: Ready? Let's listen and repeat every line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好了嗎？我們來逐句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tall retired man in his early sixties with short grey hair and a wide-brim hat, wearing a navy windbreaker, khaki trousers and cushioned walking sneakers, holding a folded paper map
script.char_b_description: a cheerful young woman around twenty-five with a long black braid over one shoulder, wearing a burgundy museum polo shirt with a round name badge, tapping the ticket screen with a pen
script.youtube_title: 【🎫買博物館票英文】「中午時段賣光了！」⏰超實用售票口對話，聽完就會買票｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜Museum Tickets
script.youtube_title_en: “The Noon Slots Are All Gone” — Buying Museum Tickets
script.youtube_description:
出國看展卻不敢開口買票？這段博物館售票口的真實對話，一集幫你打通！跟著一位阿伯在售票口練習時段制購票、確認 QR code 進館、加購語音導覽與刷卡付款。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Too shy to buy museum tickets in English? This real-life box office conversation fixes it in one episode. Follow a friendly visitor as he picks a timed entry slot, checks the QR code, adds audio guides and pays by card — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. The second half is a listen-and-repeat drill, so you can speak up on your next trip.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎫博物館買票英文｜時段入場・加購導覽・刷卡付款｜聽完就會自己買票｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在國外買門票，擔心聽不懂時段和優惠？
售票員語速飛快，到底該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進人擁擠的博物館售票口，跟著一位阿伯從選時段、確認 QR code 進館，到加購語音導覽與刷卡付款，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🎫 選時段入場：例如「the noon slots are all gone」、「what's the earliest one left?」。
📱 進館與付款：例如「just show the QR code at the door」、「Can we pay by card?」。
🎧 加購導覽：例如「are audio guides included?」、「We'll take two.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次逛博物館，原來買票可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up two paper museum tickets
script.title_quote: The noon slots are all gone

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, two tickets for today, please.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我們要兩張今天的門票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! Did you want timed entry?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！你們要選時段入場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Timed entry? What does that mean?
dialogue.zh: 時段入場？那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, you pick a time to come in.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ju pɪk ə taɪm tə kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是先選好進館的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh I see. Can we go in now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ si kæn wi ɡoʊ ɪn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 喔我懂了。我們現在可以進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So sorry, the noon slots are all gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ səˈraɪ ðə nun slɑts ər ɔl ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，中午的時段都賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, what's the earliest one left?
dialogue.zh: 呃，最早還剩下的時段是哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see, two fifteen works for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts si tu fɪfˈtin wɜrks fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看，兩點十五可以讓你們進場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine. Do we need ID for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn du wi nid aɪˈdi fɔr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好的。進場需要身分證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, just show the QR code at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp dʒʌst ʃoʊ ði kju ɑr koʊd æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 不用，在門口出示 QR code 就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Oh, are audio guides included?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。喔，票價有含語音導覽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're three dollars each, if you'd like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr θri ˈdɑlərz ith ɪf ju dəˈlaɪk/
dialogue.zh: 一部三美元，需要的話可以加購。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll take two. Can we pay by card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wil teɪk tu kæn wi peɪ baɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我們要兩部。可以用刷卡付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. That'll be thirty-three in total.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ðætlə bi ˈθɜrti θri ɪn toʊtl/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。總共是三十三美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Where do we wait for the slot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt wɛr du wi weɪt fɔr ðə slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 完美。我們要在哪裡等進場時段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just by the big doors, right over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst baɪ ðə bɪɡ dɔrz raɪt ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊那扇大門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for sorting that out for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ˈsɔrtɪŋ ðæt aʊt fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你幫我們把這些處理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy the museum! See you at two fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə mjuˈziəm si ju æt tu fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 祝參觀愉快！兩點十五見。
